messages:
amy_csm: Quick alert 11:06 UTC we saw intermittent 5xx on EU onboarding & ingest for a subset of tenants (~120). Drafting a customer note + remediation offer, need quick review.

amy_csm: ```
Subject: Notice: brief outage affecting EU onboarding (Mar 22)

Hello,

Between ~11:0611:40 UTC today, a subset of EU onboarding and indexing requests experienced intermittent failures (5xx). Our team identified the issue and applied a targeted fix; normal service has been restored.

Short root cause: a config propagation race in our auth-sync/control plane resulted in token validation errors for some onboarding paths.

What we did: hotfix + safety rollback deployed, automated reprocessing attempted for incomplete writes; manual replays scheduled where needed.

What well do next: publish full RCA within 72 hours and deploy a permanent fix with rollout gating.

Support offer: affected customers will receive one month account credit. Customers in active renewal discussions will be offered AE-managed remediation (extensions, credits, or hands-on replays). If you used SSO/VPC and still see failures, reply here or open a ticket and well prioritize an engineering replay.

Thanks  Amy, Customer Success
```

ben_support: Tone good. Add status.redwood.ai link and support portal URL. Also change "indexing" -> "indexing/ingest" for clarity.

diego_eng: RCA short: control-plane retry storm + TTL race on config propagation caused ~3% of EU onboarding requests to hand off expired tokens. Hotfix at 11:22 UTC; safety rollback at 11:38 UTC. Backfills completed for ~97%; ~3% flagged for manual replay. Permanent fix ETA: 72h (PR + canary + tests).

priya_ae: For renewal-risk accounts, prefer AE-managed handling. Ill follow up with my impacted renewal accounts after the comms go out.

marco_billing: Billing will apply the one-month credit to impacted accounts unless AE flags for manual handling.

ops-bot: Incident logged INC-20260322-1106  severity=P2  owners=eng-oncall,cs-ops.

amy_csm: Thanks all  Ill post this at 14:00 UTC to the status page and send to affected accounts. Reply here with any last edits. :thumbsup:
